result.title: IndustrialCAD-1400: Benchmarking Detailed Industrial Assemblies from Text
result.summary: Industrial assemblies require more than a recognizable shape: functional parts, interfaces, dimensions and service features must satisfy a detailed request together. We introduce IndustrialCAD-1400, a text-to-CAD benchmark for this industrial setting. Its 1,400 requests combine 400 equipment categories across 40 domains with 250 four-case design families. Family requests specify a median of 17 named component or configuration roles and six explicit numeric targets; controlled variants test whether dimensions change while shared structure is retained. Task construction draws on documented manufacturer information, owner specifications and engineering guidance. Models generate geometry programs from requests, and a common Blender environment executes them to produce scenes, optional measurements, and standardized views for evaluation. A request assessment of front, isometric, and top views measures visible component, arrangement, and interface fulfillment without requiring a single reference geometry. Five stratified panels preserve complete families while covering the benchmark exactly once, enabling balanced comparisons and separating industrial breadth from controlled numerical responsiveness. In conclusion, IndustrialCAD-1400 extends text-to-CAD from recognizable part geometry to industrial assembly synthesis under joint component, interface, spatial, and numerical specifications.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 IndustrialCAD-1400，一个面向工业装配的文本到 CAD 基准：1,400 条请求覆盖 400 类设备与 40 个领域，由设计家族组成，要求模型生成几何程序并在统一 Blender 环境中渲染、由多视角评估满足组件、接口、空间与数值规格的程度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准本身不涉及 VLM 内部推理状态或 latent 生成，但其「设计家族＋受控数值变体」和免参考多视角评分的评价设计，可能为 LVR 的受控泛化探测与视觉证据筛选提供评价思路上的参照。
